artifacts.summary: Research on retargeting --revise/--learn to the hosted sapience store, deleting the six redundant local-vault sub-modes, removing orphaned core callers, and wiring the tagged-write half of the retrieval loop. Key finding: the dispatch's claim that memory-retrieve.sh is already dead is refuted -- 25 live call sites across 12 extensions' SKILL.md files still invoke it directly and must be updated (mechanically, since sapience-retrieve.sh is a confirmed drop-in replacement).

memory_candidates.content: sapience-retrieve.sh and memory-retrieve.sh share an identical CLI signature (<description> <task_type> [focus_prompt]) and emit the identical <memory-context> envelope, so any caller of the latter can be migrated to the former by a pure script-name substitution with no surrounding logic change.

In this agent system, core task types (general/meta/markdown) route memory-context injection through a single shared call site in orchestrate-build-dispatch.sh's Stage 3.5, but every domain extension's own research/implementation SKILL.md carries an independent, inline Stage 4a block making the same call directly. Swapping the shared call site does not touch the per-extension ones -- they must be updated separately, one per extension skill file.
